food_prompt:
Look at this food photo. First identify each dish, then list ingredients with gram estimates.
Return only valid JSON:
{"dishes":[{"name":string,"cuisine":string,"ingredients":[{"name":string,"amount_g":number}]}]}
For weights: a standard dinner plate is ~25cm, a cup is ~240ml, a fist-sized portion is ~150g.
